evidence: Inspected decompiled/main/main_0112.c:40594-40641 and callers main_0111.c:45659-45663 and main_0112.c:22712-22716. The routine converts two scalar inputs through convert_attribute_value_to_float_div_100 and uses SIMD comparisons before returning 0, 1, or 2, but the comparison direction/meaning does not support a reliable semantic label.

Reads attribute-context status selectors 1 and 2 using attribute_context_status_value_get (decompiled/main/main_0116.c:26600-26605). The body returns true for an explicit set of accepted ordered status pairs and false otherwise (main_0116.c:26606-26678); caller stores the predicate result (main_0115.c:7486-7488). This names only the observed whitelist predicate, without assigning business meaning to the codes.

Inspected decompiled/main/main_0058.c:47941-47975. Requires a nonnull record whose word at +0 equals 0x21, reads +8, checks the accepted status helper, consults another helper, selects a value from +0x10 or +0xc, and invokes an unresolved helper. No indexed caller is available; record/helper semantics are insufficient for a behavior name.

Inspected decompiled/main/main_0030.c:5609-5653. After status/helper guards, scans 0x38 halfword entries starting at an input-relative offset 0x2c, calls an unresolved helper for nonzero entries, and may invoke another helper with immediate 0x9c and a stack buffer. Callers decompiled/main/main_0030.c:1691-1695 and 4460-4464 do not establish the buffer or entry semantics.

Inspected decompiled/main/main_0054.c:22890-22964 and its forwarding caller main_0054.c:22885-22888. The function invokes multiple unresolved helpers, makes status-conditioned branches and quotient calculations, and finishes with a tail call. Available names do not identify the operation, so a narrower semantic label is unsupported.
